name: PaddleFitHub AI Agent
description: AI Agent interface for PaddleFitHub pickleball calculators, equipment fitting algorithms, and round robin tournament schedule generation.

skills.name: Grip Size Calculator
skills.description: Calculates recommended pickleball paddle grip size based on hand measurements or height.

skills.name: Paddle Weight Advisor
skills.description: Recommends paddle weight in ounces and grams based on play style, arm sensitivity, and duration.

skills.name: Paddle Shape Advisor
skills.description: Compares Standard, Hybrid, and Elongated paddle shapes for player priorities.

skills.name: Core Thickness Advisor
skills.description: Analyzes 14mm, 16mm, and 20mm core thickness tradeoffs for power vs touch.

skills.name: Overgrip Weight Adjustment
skills.description: Calculates static weight addition, grip expansion, and balance shift from overgrip wraps.

skills.name: Arm-Friendly Paddle Finder
skills.description: Recommends equipment specs for shock absorption and vibration reduction.

skills.name: Round-Robin Generator
skills.description: Generates fair tournament rotation schedules for Doubles and Singles pickleball.
